messages.subject: StatET moved / Closing of this list
messages.subject_clean: StatET moved / Closing of this list
messages.body_plain:
Dear StatET-users,

as most of you already know, the StatET project moved to Eclipse 
Foundation. The new homepage is:

https://www.eclipse.org/statet

For this reason this mailing list at R-Forge will be closed. Please 
subscribe to the new StatET users mailing list at eclipse.org:

https://accounts.eclipse.org/mailing-list/statet-users

A new version of StatET will be announced at the new mailing list soon.

Best regards,
Stephan
_______________________________________________
StatET-user mailing list
https://lists.r-forge.r-project.org/cgi-bin/mailman/listinfo/statet-user
